description.zh: Anatomy 等轴测讲解图：把一个技术概念做成一台真实的小机器（锁、量表、绘图仪、发动机……），输出可交互的 SVG/HTML 页面、单个 SVG、React 组件或 A4 PDF。先用 apply_skill 应用 anatomy 技能并按其指引编写 anatomy/figures/<名字>/build.mjs，再用本工具运行：action="run" 在工作目录的 anatomy/ 下执行 `node <脚本> …`（构建、--audit 几何审计、scripts/capture.mjs 截图、drive.mjs、lines.mjs、print.mjs 打印 PDF）；action="open" 在浏览器中打开做好的页面。经用户确认后执行；没有 Node.js 时首次运行会自动下载。
description.en: Anatomy isometric explainer figures: turn a technical idea into a real little machine (a lock, a gauge, a plotter, an engine…) and output an interactive SVG/HTML page, a lone SVG, React components or A4 PDFs. Apply the anatomy skill with apply_skill first and write anatomy/figures/<name>/build.mjs as it instructs, then use this tool: action="run" runs `node <script> …` in the workspace's anatomy/ folder (builds, --audit geometry checks, scripts/capture.mjs screenshots, drive.mjs, lines.mjs, print.mjs PDFs); action="open" shows a finished page in the browser. Runs after user confirmation; downloads Node.js on first use when it is missing.

action.description: run：执行 node 脚本（默认）；open：在浏览器打开 path 指向的 .html/.svg/.pdf

args.description: run 时：node 之后的参数，第一个是 anatomy/ 下的脚本，如 ["figures/lock/build.mjs", "--light"] 或 ["scripts/capture.mjs", "figures/lock/lock.html", "--out", "shots/lock.png"]

path.description: open 时：anatomy/ 下的页面，如 figures/lock/lock.html

action.description: run: run a node script (default); open: show the .html/.svg/.pdf at path in the browser

args.description: for run: arguments after node, starting with a script under anatomy/, e.g. ["figures/lock/build.mjs", "--light"] or ["scripts/capture.mjs", "figures/lock/lock.html", "--out", "shots/lock.png"]

path.description: for open: a page under anatomy/, e.g. figures/lock/lock.html
